_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE running any Gen51 test. Strategy fixed: C* (frozen E2+O3, crypto 10 majors daily, 7.5 bp, backtest leverage 0.79). Challenge at 1.0x backtest risk, funded at 0.4x (gen34 two-speed).
G51a_daily_equity_stop: close all positions for the rest of the day when equity falls to 75% of the firm's daily loss limit below start-of-day equity (CFT 1-Phase: -3%); assume the exit fills 0.3% worse than the stop; positions resume next day
G51b_cushion_scaling: each day, risk multiplier = clip(cushion, 0.25, 1) where cushion = (equity - max-loss floor) / max_loss; i.e. full size with the whole buffer, smaller near the floor
evaluation: prop engine (src/qpl/lab/propfirms.py), every historical start 2018-2026; firms CFT 1-Phase $100k (primary) and FTMO 2-Step $100k; budget 5, 1 account, 24 months
pass_rule: on the primary firm: pass rate per attempt up by >= 5 percentage points AND average 24-month net profit higher than plain C*; also report FTMO
caveat: daily worst/best come from daily candles with all coins at their lows together (conservative); the stop assumes it can be executed (Bybit stop orders / API)
